blocks.alt: A man carrying a child away from a building destroyed by the earthquakes in Venezuela.

blocks.text: Back-to-back earthquakes have upended life across Venezuela. Your gift delivers help now.
100% of net proceeds go to earthquake relief.

On June 24, two powerful earthquakes struck northern Venezuela less than a minute apart, the strongest the country has seen in over a century. La Guaira and Caracas were hit hardest. Thousands of families lost their homes, and many are now sleeping outside, cut off from clean water and medical care.

blocks.alt: An excavator and workers clearing rubble from a collapsed building.
A damaged apartment tower standing above the surrounding city.
Two people walking out of a building wrecked by the earthquake.
A woman standing among the rubble of destroyed homes.

blocks.text: In the weeks after the earthquakes we opened two temporary support centres for displaced families. Both have since closed. We are now building a permanent centre in La Guaira.

blocks.alt: Map of Venezuela marking Caracas and La Guaira, the areas hit by the June 2026 earthquakes.

blocks.text: 100% of net proceeds benefit children and families displaced by the June 2026 earthquakes in Venezuela.

Funds raised from this campaign will go towards the construction of VVF's permanent support centre in La Guaira. When it opens it will provide shelter, nutrition and medical care to 500 displaced children and their families.
